description: MUTATES Raisely data: creates OR updates a supporter/donor, matched by email (safer than a plain create — no duplicates). Raisely API: POST /users/upsert with the body wrapped as { data: {...} }. Typed: email (the match key), firstName, lastName; everything else (phoneNumber, address, public, private, ...) via `fields`. Returns the upserted user.

email.description: The user's email address — the match key for upsert. Required.

fields.description: Additional documented Raisely fields to send in the JSON write body's `data` object — merged OVER the typed fields above.

name: upsert_user
title: Upsert a user
